algorithm_long: Composition-only steel yield-strength regression using an unmodified TabPFN-v2 foundation checkpoint and a conventional baseline selected within each official training fold. A 42-configuration baseline search is followed by an independent per-outer-fold inner-CV comparison of three feature sets, two TabPFN ensemble sizes, mean/median prediction summaries and four mixture weights, with baseline-only as an additional option. All five final models, contexts and mixtures are frozen before final test inference and native Matbench scoring. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN.
notes: Only matbench_steels is submitted. Native five-fold MAE=76.59472316987244 MPa, std=12.406993875998648 MPa, all312 predictions retained. Seed1701, threefold inner CV independently for each outer fold; no pooled outer-score selection. Development pilot used only fold0 training rows; final configurations are reselected independently within every outer training fold. No official test scores/labels or public prediction files are used to train, calibrate, tune or select. Foundation gradient updates=0. The original TabPFN-v2 checkpoint and mandatory license/attribution are identified in README and source-lock. Actual runtime: Python3.12.3, PyTorch2.13.0+cu126, one A100-SXM4-80GB; conventional stage executes on CPU, TabPFN on CUDA. Saved-model replay and source validation evidence are supplied separately; public acceptance is determined by maintainers.
